_comment: Manifest schema for the Nile testnet equivalence-test fixture. This file is a SCHEMA placeholder — actual values get filled in when scripts/build-nile-fixture.sh runs against a real snapshot. Fields:

_schema.snapshot_kind: "lite" | "full" — lite is sufficient for dbfork equivalence
_schema.upstream_backup: the trond snapshot --backup ID used as the canonical pin
_schema.block_height: block number at which the snapshot was taken
_schema.generated_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of fixture generation
_schema.stores: map of store-name → SHA256 hex over sorted file list
_schema.consumed_by: the test that reads this fixture
